title: DAVSP: Safety Alignment for Large Vision-Language Models via Deep Aligned Visual Safety Prompt
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety alignment to resist malicious queries (e.g., hacking, Ponzi schemes) in Large Vision-Language Models. While it evaluates the model's ability to refuse 'unethical' or 'harmful' requests using standard safety benchmarks, it does not conduct a study or evaluation of religious traditions, moral reasoning frameworks, or specific ethical systems.
